title: IPCC Tier 2 Livestock GHG Uncertainty Calculator

creators.name: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT (CGIAR)

description: Free web-based cattle GHG uncertainty calculator for national greenhouse-gas inventory compilers: Monte Carlo (IPCC Approach 2) uncertainty analysis of IPCC Tier 2 cattle emission estimates (enteric fermentation CH4, manure management CH4 and N2O, pasture deposition N2O), with correlated sampling, activity-data vs emission-factor decomposition, sensitivity analysis (SRC and PRCC), trend uncertainty, and outputs formatted for IPCC 2006 Vol. 1 Ch. 3 Table 3.3 and UNFCCC Enhanced Transparency Framework reporting. Live app: https://mlolita26.shinyapps.io/cattle-ghg-uncertainty/ . Website: https://cgiar-climate-data-hub.github.io/cattle-ghg-uncertainty/ . Developed by the Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT under the CGIAR Climate Action Programme.
notes: Funded by the Global Methane Hub, grant R-2026-01051 (project D614: GMH Emissions Uncertainty).
